carried: Bounded wait while the Kokoro service is booting or restarting (connection refused), so a sentence spoken in that window is not dropped.
Streaming synthesis into the player to cut TTFA below one whole sentence's synthesis time.
Moving playback to the central house speech processor (Music Assistant play_announcement); only the client's playback step should change.
Updating momentum's hooks (momentum-stop-hook.ts:386, shared/voice-loader.ts:142) to stop passing --model; momentum is not wired into ~/.claude/settings.json.
